resources.string: StandBy and the screen-off Halo show over the lock screen.
MagicOS blocks showing over the lock screen by default. Without this permission, StandBy and the screen-off Halo stay hidden while the phone is locked.
StandBy starts by itself when plugged in, without opening Bulle.
For StandBy to open by itself when the phone charges sideways, MagicOS must allow Bulle to show windows from the background.
Turn on “Display pop-up windows while running in the background”.
The StandBy Photos page plays an album from your gallery. Photos are read on the phone, never copied or sent.
Trigger a halo, show the edge zones in colour for 5 s or start StandBy. Each test is noted in the island log.
In landscape, the zones stay thin so they don’t cover the top controls of a video (YouTube…). At 0, the Panel no longer opens in landscape.
Failed: is Shizuku running and Bulle allowed?
Apps with an active service. “Manage” opens their info page (Force stop). With Shizuku, “Stop” closes them directly.
Apps with an active service. “Stop” force-stops them via Shizuku.
